NeoNilam BASE

Your formulation shouldn’t
have to start from zero.

NeoNilam BASE is a plant-derived nutrient liquid designed as a starting matrix for crop-nutrition and biostimulant products.

Request Sample ↗

Instead of beginning with an empty carrier, formulators can start with a liquid material that already contains recovered macro- and micronutrient components.

Benefits

A more functional starting material

Begin with a nutrient-containing matrix rather than plain water.

Formulation freedom

Add nutrients, humic/fulvic substances, amino-acid systems, botanical extracts or other compatible actives around your own target.

Build differentiated products

Develop crop-, geography- or brand-specific products from a common starting base.

B2B by design

NeoNilam BASE is intended as an ingredient platform for agricultural-input manufacturers, not a fixed farmer-facing product.

Development profile

N · P · K · Ca · Mg · S · Fe · Mn · B · Cu · Zn
